en: Black-and-white postcard showing a mountain scene with dramatic rocky peaks and snow in the background, dense conifer forest on the slopes, and a small building complex in the foreground labeled as a café. Several tables and chairs sit outside the main low building, with a two-story chalet-style structure attached. Italian text is printed at the top describing the café and location, including the elevation.
